estimand.unit: one public maintenance brief from one canonical GitHub repository
estimand.target_population: eligible public GitHub maintenance records frozen before task authoring
estimand.development_partition_use: measurement development only; excluded from confirmatory inference
estimand.safety_control_use: separate non-inferiority and critical-failure gates; never pooled into the primary outcome

repository: The repository is public, non-archived, non-fork, and has an OSI-identifiable license at the frozen source commit.
The exact source commit and tree are reachable from the canonical HTTPS GitHub repository at the selection cutoff.
The source can be archived during trusted preparation without submodules, unsafe links, secret-bearing paths, generated dependency trees, or network-dependent trial setup.
A repository may contribute at most one task across development, target holdout, and safety control partitions.
maintenance_record: The record is a public issue, pull request, or commit belonging to the selected repository.
The record describes or implements a concrete software-maintenance concern that can be investigated from the frozen source tree.
The record predates task authoring and has a content snapshot with an immutable SHA-256 digest.
The record does not expose benchmark labels, a reference plan, or the expected treatment result.
task: The public brief asks for a plan, not an implementation, and requires no network access or package installation during the Agent trial.
The brief is treatment-blind and names only evidence available in the frozen archive.
Host-only expected constraints, permitted paths, and review labels are authored after repository selection and never enter the public task, archive, trace, or Study event.
The task is assigned to exactly one preregistered stratum before either Skill arm is run.

sampling.population_snapshot: Freeze every eligible record and its eligibility decision after trusted source-preparation feasibility checks but before selecting or authoring tasks.
sampling.selection_seed: Freeze one unpredictable 256-bit seed before inspecting treatment outputs.
sampling.algorithm: Within each partition and stratum, sort eligible records by SHA256(seed + newline + canonical lower-case repository URL + newline + public record URL + newline), then select the first quota while enforcing one repository cluster globally.
sampling.replacement: Source-archive feasibility is an eligibility condition evaluated before the population snapshot. After selection there is no replacement; any selected source or receipt failure invalidates the frame and requires a new versioned population and selection identity.

preparation.boundary: All GitHub reads, source archiving, license checks, task-image construction, and digest generation occur in trusted setup --prepare before preview approval.
trial_restrictions: No clone, fetch, install, download, build, Docker-socket access, or mutable reference resolution is permitted in an Agent trial.
Each trial receives one digest-verified read-only source archive plus its public brief.
Private labels remain mode 0600 on the host; only their digests are bound into preparation and approval.
required_receipts: remote commit/tree provenance receipt per selected repository
license path and digest per selected repository
source archive and source manifest digest per selected repository
public task and host-only private-label manifest digests

sealing.development: Development tasks may be opened after their separate preview is approved; they do not license holdout access.
sealing.holdout: Target holdouts and safety controls are sealed before development outputs are inspected and receive a separate preview, approval, budget, and execution identity.
sealing.contamination: Any prompt, expected value, source record, or repository cluster exposed before holdout execution invalidates that task and triggers the preregistered deterministic replacement rule.
sealing.approval: Every Study requires an exact finite preview. This protocol authorizes no execution or spend.

analysis_constraints: Attempts estimate repeatability but do not increase the number of independent task clusters.
The primary analysis clusters by canonical repository and uses only the 192 target holdouts.
Safety controls, deterministic safety gates, qualitative judge labels, mechanism evidence, and efficiency evidence remain separate.
A power simulation over the completed frozen frame is required before the holdout preview may be approved.
A same-model-family judge is advisory until independently reviewed calibration and validation satisfy the declared gate.

readiness.fail_closed: No development or holdout spec, source lock, task archive, or paid preview may be generated until the complete bundle validates.
